VERIFICATION 2026-08-21 (loop 500), because this is the one of the three stale pending-build notes with no golden test behind it. Read straight out of missfortune.bin.json: TotalDamage is a GameCalculationModified whose mModifiedGameCalculation is TotalDamagePerSecond and whose mMultiplier is the BaseDuration DataValue - so TotalDamage = perSecond x duration is not an approximation, it is the BINs own definition, and the per-second curation reproduces it exactly at full exposure. BaseDamagePerSecond = [20,35,50,65,80,...], BaseDuration = 2.0 flat. ONE TRAP worth recording: the spell carries TWO APRatioPerSecond values, 0.6 and 0.9. The 0.9 lives under DataValuesModeOverride/cherry - the Arena override, the same mode-value distinction the Maokai note draws. ChampionBinParser.ParseDataValues reads mSpell[DataValues] by direct property lookup and DataValuesModeOverride is a SIBLING key, so an Arena value can never leak into an SR number. 0.6 is the right read.
